basic_info.description: 👋 I'm Ella Rekow. I am a Software Engineering who graduated from Iowa State in May of 2024. A couple things I love (in no particular order) are my houseplants, hiking, and my rescue dog Summer. I would like to think I am known promoting kindness in the tech community though my TikTok platform and more recently improving the safety of aircraft software. I also love learning, from the biology of the plants I own, to history both recent and far past, to the quickly changing advancements in current tech! (I am not kidding I love reading academic papers in my free time just ask me about it). While this website could always be updated I hope it gives you a glimpse into some of the highlights in my overall career!

projects.title: Women In Science and Engineering Community Leader
projects.description: Similar to a learning community, I continue to run a small group of Women who are pursuing degrees in Tech. We meet on a weekly basis and participate in various activities from just hanging out and chatting to talking to guest speakers who are working in the field, resume reviews, and more! The focus is creating a community of girls who can help each other and build their skills and have a strong support system.

projects.title: Discord Bot
projects.description: Created A fun discord bot to keep track of interaction in the server. With each message without spamming a user would earn 1 pothos (name of my favorite plant).

projects.title: FIRST Robotics Challenge Robot
projects.description: Sophomore year of High School I was appointed lead programmer of the 525 Robotics team where my teammates and I developed embedded code to earn two separate tickets to the world competition. 21+ different autonomous methods were deployed to our robot making us one of the most versatile autonomous robots in the entire world and being called the ''5th highest rated autonomous'' competitor there.
